description: This file defines interfaces and factory classes for the MediaPipelineModuleService in the Rialto media server IPC component. It includes class declarations for the service interface and its factory, along with methods for client connection management.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaPipelineModuleService.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineModuleService
classes.description: Interface for the media pipeline module service, including connection management methods.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IMediaPipelineModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaPipelineModuleService, given a media pipeline service reference.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles logic when an IPC client connects.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles logic when an IPC client disconnects.
